infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: VoltMate uses the camera to scan EV sub-meter kWh readings and vehicle dashboard SOC% locally on your device.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: VoltMate requires location access to find nearby P2P host chargers and plan highway charging stops.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: VoltMate uses background location to alert you when approaching your booked society gate.

plugins.cameraPermissionText: VoltMate requires camera access to read electricity meters and vehicle RC cards via on-device ML Kit.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow VoltMate to locate nearby community EV plugs.
